cards.text: Israel's camped on the plains of Moab (Numbers 26:3). Now meet five sisters from the clans of Manasseh: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah. They're the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, and friend, they are about to walk up and say something.

cards.question: The five daughters of Zelophehad go to make their case. Where do they go?

answers.text: To the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
To the banks of the Jordan

cards.text: They stand before Moses, Israel's leader, Eleazar the priest, the leaders AND the whole congregation. That's not asking your boss for a raise, friend, that's asking at the company-wide meeting with the microphone ON.
The sisters start with their dad: he died in the wilderness, and he had no sons. Then they clear something up about how he died.

cards.question: Korah was the Levite who led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron (Numbers 16:1-3). The daughters of Zelophehad say their father was among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD.

cards.text: Zelophehad wasn't with Korah's crowd. His daughters say he died because of his own sin.
Then they ask, "Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons?" Friend, I've heard closing arguments with less punch than that one sentence.

cards.question: So what do the daughters of Zelophehad ask to be given?

answers.text: A seat among their clan's leaders

cards.question: Five sisters just asked for property, in front of everyone. What does Moses do with their case?

answers.text: He brings it before the LORD
He hands it to the leaders

cards.text: And the LORD answers him. Ohhh, friend, it is getting GOOD.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses that the daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly.
The LORD tells Moses to give the sisters property and transfer their father's ___ to them.

cards.text: The LORD doesn't stop at a "You certainly must…" for these five. He tells Moses to say a new rule to all the Israelites.

cards.question: Under the LORD's new rule for Israel, if a man dies and leaves no son, who gets his inheritance?
Under the LORD's inheritance rule for Israel, if a man dies and leaves no son and no daughter, his inheritance goes to his ___.

cards.text: If he has no brothers, it goes to his father's brothers. We're climbing this family tree one branch at a time, friend.

cards.question: Under the LORD's inheritance rule for Israel, if a man dies with no children and no brothers, and his father has no brothers, the inheritance goes to another tribe.

cards.text: It goes to the next of kin from his clan, and the LORD makes it a statutory ordinance for the Israelites. Five sisters ask ONE question and it becomes the law for a whole nation, while I sat in the back of a junk drawer for YEARS and couldn't get one person to remember I was in there.
